name: Bades Bay
hero_subtitle: A wide sweep of beach near historic Badis — sand, boats and space west of Al Hoceima.

overview.title: Space and a wider horizon
overview.p1: Bades Bay (Badis) opens into a broad beach framed by the Rif edge — a different scale from the compact coves closer to town.
overview.p2: Kayaks and short boat trips appear in season. The nearby Spanish rock of Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera is a striking offshore landmark from certain angles.
overview.p3: Come for sand and space. Bring supplies; services are lighter than on Quemado.

q1.question: How far is Bades Bay from Al Hoceima?
q1.answer: It is located west of town — plan for a half-day or full-day transfer and beach outing.

q2.question: Can you swim at Bades Bay?
q2.answer: Yes, when sea conditions allow. As an open Mediterranean bay, always pay attention to local advisory flags.

q3.question: What is the historical significance of Badis?
q3.answer: The wider area holds deep historical layers from coastal trade and maritime defense; today, the scenic beach is the main leisure attraction.

q4.question: Are boat trips available?
q4.answer: Local boat operators offer seasonal coastal trips — always confirm duration and price in advance.

q5.question: Is Bades Bay quieter than Quemado?
q5.answer: Yes, it generally offers a much more relaxed and spacious atmosphere, especially outside peak summer weekends.
